title: 7B INT6 Scale Offset Fix
root_cause: Hardcoded scale_off=16 for all INT6 files. 7B INT6 requires scale_off=20 (16-byte header + 4 reserved bytes before scales). This 4-byte offset error caused scale misread → garbage FP → abs_sum ~5.7e23.
fix_summary: Made scale_off dimension-aware: 16 for 0.5B (M=4864,K=896), 20 for 7B (M=18944,K=3584). Also: dimension-aware sidecar path selection, correct read order for 7B, file size validation, comprehensive provenance logging.
D_root_cause: scale_off hardcoded to 16; 7B INT6 requires 20 (header + 4 reserved bytes)
E_fix_summary: Dimension-aware scale_off: M==18944&&K==3584 → 20, else → 16. Also dimension-aware sidecar dir selection.
L_c4_policy_result: N≤4→PRT AVX2 path, N>4→native_prefill — correct routing
